[SWS_CM_00139] Default value of Minimum Send Interval and disabling Mini- mum Send Interval monitoring for Events
⌈
If the configured Minimum Send Interval
(ServiceInterfaceDeploymentElement.minimumSendInterval) of an event
has the value 0, the Minimum Send Interval monitoring shall not be active for the corre-
sponding event, i.e., ara::com will not limit the Tx frequency by dropping transmission
requests. For each Event of a ServiceInterfaceDeployment, 0 shall be the de-
fault value for the corresponding ServiceInterfaceDeploymentElement.mini-
mumSendInterval. This means that unless ServiceInterfaceDeploymentEle-
ment.minimumSendInterval for a given event is explicitly configured to be > 0, the
Tx rate is not limited by ara::com.
⌋
